move.name: Move
move.description: Move your token up to its Speed, accounting for terrain, occupied spaces and control.

standingJump.name: Standing Jump
standingJump.description: Spend 1 Movement. Jump up to 2 squares to an available space. You cannot jump over a standing creature.

runningJump.name: Running Jump
runningJump.description: After moving at least 1 square, jump straight ahead up to 3 squares into an available space as part of the same Move. You cannot jump over a standing creature.

climb.name: Climb
climb.description: Spend 1 Movement. Check Athletics against the surface difficulty. Great, full and partial success allow 3, 2 and 1 squares respectively. Failure gives no movement. A natural 1 causes a fall.

step.name: Step
step.description: Spend 1 Movement to enter an adjacent available square. You cannot enter difficult terrain. Stepping does not trigger movement or control-exit Interventions.

stand.name: Stand
stand.description: Spend 1 Movement. Remove Prone in the selected token’s effect panel.

dash.name: Dash
dash.description: Spend 1 Impact to gain 1 additional Movement.

swapPlaces.name: Swap Places
swapPlaces.description: The initiator spends 1 Impact and a willing adjacent ally spends 1 Intervention. Resolve Interventions triggered by the initiator first, then swap simultaneously. Neither participant can be Large or larger. Both must fit their new spaces.

prepare.name: Prepare
prepare.description: Spend 1 Impact. Mark 1 additional Intervention until the start of your next turn.

aidAlly.name: Help an Ally
aidAlly.description: Spend 1 Impact. You need a free hand or a two-handed weapon and an adjacent ally who is neither Grappled nor Immobilized. With a willing conscious ally, or on a successful Forceful Pull, move them 1 square to an available space next to you or leave them in place. A conscious ally may stand.

forceAidAlly.name: Forceful Pull
forceAidAlly.description: Check Athletics against the ally’s Fortitude. If the ally is unconscious, reduce difficulty by 5.

freeAlly.name: Free an Ally
freeAlly.description: Check Athletics against the grappler’s Fortitude. On success, end one selected Grapple affecting the adjacent ally.

trip.name: Trip
trip.description: Make a Maneuver against the target’s Reflex. Apply Prone according to the final degree.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Make a Maneuver against the target’s Fortitude. Apply Grappled according to the final degree.

escape.name: Escape
escape.description: Choose Athletics or Acrobatics and target the grappler. Check against its Fortitude. On success, end one selected Grapple.

reposition.name: Reposition
reposition.description: Make a Maneuver against the target’s Fortitude. Move the token manually according to the final degree.

shove.name: Shove
shove.description: Make a Maneuver against the target’s Fortitude. Move the token away manually according to the final degree.

slip.name: Slip Through
slip.description: During movement, check Acrobatics against the selected enemy’s Reflex. Resolve further movement and Quick Strike according to the final degree and formation.

hide.name: Hide
hide.description: Select enemies without direct line of sight. Compare one Stealth check against each enemy’s Awareness. On success, resolve invisibility and the unknown space separately for that enemy.

firstAid.name: First Aid
firstAid.description: Choose one adjacent recipient. Check Medicine against difficulty 5. On success, the recipient recovers 1d4 HP. Once per encounter per recipient.

distract.name: Distract
distract.description: Check Deception against the Awareness of an enemy who can see you. On success, apply Off Guard through the end of the target’s next turn.

demoralize.name: Demoralize
demoralize.description: Check Intimidation against the Will of a target within 10 squares. On success, apply −2 to its AC thresholds, defense stats and attacks through the end of its next turn.

selfDefense.name: Self-Defense
selfDefense.description: Make a Directed Defense against a qualifying directed attack vs. AC. Use Fortitude against melee and Reflex against ranged attacks.

counteraction.name: Counteraction
counteraction.description: Use the defense stat checked by the triggering action. Compare the roll against the triggering total.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.description: Against a qualifying area, choose a Dodge option from the source card. Move the token manually.

quickStrike.name: Quick Strike
quickStrike.description: On a qualifying trigger, declare Quick Strike, target the provoking enemy and make a melee attack. Requires 1 Intervention.

coverAlly.name: Cover an Ally
coverAlly.description: After all Defensive actions, pick one remaining damage die for an adjacent ally. Take that damage instead without reduction or redirection. Other effects stay with the ally. Costs 1 Intervention.

combatMaster.name: Combat Master
combatMaster.description: When declaring an attack, you may increase its Combat Die by one step. Once per day.

invocation.name: Invocation
invocation.description: Choose one available hand and one spell. A weapon hand can use Blade; a shield hand can use Shadow Shield. Ordinary Invocation costs 1 Impact and 1 Magic Power.

doubleInvocation.name: Double Invocation
doubleInvocation.description: Choose one Invocation per hand and their order, or one two-handed Invocation. Choose the second target and other details after resolving the first Invocation. Use the costs on the card and in the rulebook.

transferItem.name: Transfer an Item
transferItem.description: Choose one type of item and an amount for an adjacent ally. After resolving any triggered Interventions, move the items to their inventory. This action cannot transfer weapons or Shields from the held equipment system.

reload.name: Reload Firearm
reload.description: Choose a carried unloaded firearm you are proficient with. It becomes loaded when you finish this activity.

bindWounds.name: Bind Wounds
bindWounds.description: Requires Medicine. Restore all ordinary HP to yourself or one participant in the Short Rest.

fieldRecovery.name: Field Recovery
fieldRecovery.description: Restore all ordinary HP to up to 10 participating allies, including yourself.

recoverResource.name: Recover Strength
recoverResource.description: Restore 1 point of one of your class resources. Warlocks restore all class resources to their maxima.

endEffect.name: End an Effect
endEffect.description: Choose a persistent effect on one participant. If it has a difficulty, make the required check and remove it on success. Otherwise remove it immediately.

Builtin.readOnly: Built-in ability. View only; cannot be edited or deleted.
Builtin.selfDefenseDescription: Make a Directed Defense against an eligible triggering action and apply the standard Directed Defense outcome.
Builtin.selfDefenseResolution: Natural 1: failure. Success when the defense total meets or exceeds the triggering action: against a directed attack vs. AC, remove one highest remaining damage die and lower its Effect degree by 1. Natural 20: completely cancel the action, except when the triggering attack also rolled a natural 20, in which case defense is a normal success.
Builtin.selfDefenseLimits: Reach attacks remain melee. Self-Defense is unavailable against an area of effect. A specific card may replace the chosen defense, Combat Die, or another explicitly named part. Apply direct held-item modifiers; do not add AC.
